title: The Bell-Ringer
html:
A bell that has not rung in Halden's lifetime rang on Tuesday, in a room he sealed thirty-one years ago.

About

Given byHalden Rooke
Level12
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points3

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Halden Rooke (outdoors near Binx Crypt) to get the quest.
  2. Go down through the to the bell chamber.
  3. Kill the Bell-Ringer in the bell chamber.
  4. Report back to Halden Rooke and choose your reward to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold480
Character XP21,000
Quest points3
ItemsWick Candle
Choose oneSilver Longsword
or Silver Torso

What Halden Rooke says

Halden Rooke: Ferris Wick made candles. Good ones.

Halden Rooke: My mother kept a pair on the shelf for years and never once burned them. Said they were too fine for a Tuesday.

You: Whatever was ringing that bell, it wasn't Ferris.

Halden Rooke: No. And now it isn't anything at all.

Halden Rooke: That's the best either of us was ever going to get out of this. Take your pick of what's on the table.

Handing it in

"Take your pick of what's on the table."

The Bell-Ringer
